title: Work IQ: invoke custom agents and agents that call third-party tools
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates the licence required to control tools tenant-wide. Microsoft's updated Agent 365 service description includes that capability with a Microsoft cloud subscription, rather than requiring E7, G7 or Agent 365. The roadmap facts and cited control operations are supported.
